typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{ACTION CODE} as string,
		{MEETING ID} as string,
		{MEETING DATE} as string,
		{MEETING START TIME} as string,
		{MEETING END TIME} as string,
		{PRESENTING AGENT} as string,
		{ATTENDING AGENT} as string,
		STATUS as string,
		{MEETING EVENT TYPE} as string,
		{FORMAL/INFORMAL} as string,
		LANGUAGE as string,
		{MAX SEATING CAPACITY} as string,
		FACILITY_UID as string,
		MEETING_NOTES as string,
		{MEETING ROOM} as string,
		OWNER as string,
		FILE_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['raw/ib_kpma_seminar_update_*']) ~> source1
ConditionalSplit2@toSFDC derive(End_Time__c = toTimestamp(concat({MEETING DATE},' ', {MEETING END TIME}), 'MM/dd/yyyy hh:mm aa'),
		Start_Time__c = toTimestamp(concat({MEETING DATE},' ', {MEETING START TIME}), 'MM/dd/yyyy hh:mm aa'),
		Attending_Agents = split({ATTENDING AGENT}, ' ')) ~> DerivedColumn1
ConditionalSplit1@pastMeetings select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		Id = {MEETING ID},
		Presenting_Agent__c = {PRESENTING AGENT},
		Status__c = STATUS,
		Note__c = MEETING_NOTES,
		each(match(startsWith(name,'Attending_Agent_')))
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select1
ConditionalSplit3@validAgent split(End_Time__c < currentTimestamp(),
	disjoint: false) ~> ConditionalSplit1@(pastMeetings, futureMeetings)
DerivedColumn6 select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		Id = {MEETING ID},
		Meeting_Date__c = {MEETING DATE},
		Start_Time__c,
		End_Time__c,
		Presenting_Agent__c = {PRESENTING AGENT},
		Status__c = STATUS,
		Meeting_Type__c = {MEETING EVENT TYPE},
		Meeting_FormalInformal__c = {FORMAL/INFORMAL},
		Language__c = LANGUAGE,
		Maximum_Capacity__c = {MAX SEATING CAPACITY},
		Facility__c = FACILITY_UID,
		Note__c = MEETING_NOTES,
		Meeting_Room__c = {MEETING ROOM},
		OwnerId = OWNER,
		each(match(startsWith(name,'Attending_Agent_')))
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select2
source1 derive(ADFId__c = uuid()) ~> AddADFId
AddADFId split(isNull({ACTION CODE})||isNull({MEETING ID})||isNull({PRESENTING AGENT})||(upper({ACTION CODE}) != 'U'),
	disjoint: false) ~> ConditionalSplit2@(toReject, toSFDC)
ConditionalSplit2@toReject derive(REJECT_REASON = concatWS(',', iif(isNull({ACTION CODE})||isNull({MEETING ID})||(isNull({PRESENTING AGENT})), concat('ADF:Required Field Contains NULL Value: ', iif(isNull({ACTION CODE}), 'ACTION CODE ', ''), iif(isNull({MEETING ID}), 'MEETING ID ', ''), iif(isNull({PRESENTING AGENT}), 'PRESENTING AGENT ', '')), ''), iif(upper({ACTION CODE}) != 'U', 'ADF:Required Field Contains INVALID Value: ACTION CODE'))) ~> rejectReason
rejectReason select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		REJECT_REASON
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select3
DerivedColumn1 derive(agents_num = size(Attending_Agents)) ~> DerivedColumn3
DerivedColumn3 derive(Attending_Agent_1__c = iif(agents_num >= 1, Attending_Agents[1], toString(null())),
		Attending_Agent_2__c = iif(agents_num >= 2, Attending_Agents[2], toString(null())),
		Attending_Agent_3__c = iif(agents_num >= 3, Attending_Agents[3], toString(null())),
		Attending_Agent_4__c = iif(agents_num >= 4, Attending_Agents[4], toString(null())),
		Attending_Agent_5__c = iif(agents_num >= 5, Attending_Agents[5], toString(null())),
		Attending_Agent_6__c = iif(agents_num >= 6, Attending_Agents[6], toString(null())),
		Attending_Agent_7__c = iif(agents_num >= 7, Attending_Agents[7], toString(null())),
		Attending_Agent_8__c = iif(agents_num >= 8, Attending_Agents[8], toString(null())),
		Attending_Agent_9__c = iif(agents_num >= 9, Attending_Agents[9], toString(null()))) ~> DerivedColumn4
DerivedColumn4 split((agents_num < 10)&&(isNull(Attending_Agent_1__c)||in([15,18], length(Attending_Agent_1__c)))&&(isNull(Attending_Agent_2__c)||in([15,18], length(Attending_Agent_2__c)))&&(isNull(Attending_Agent_3__c)||in([15,18], length(Attending_Agent_3__c)))&&(isNull(Attending_Agent_4__c)||in([15,18], length(Attending_Agent_4__c)))&&(isNull(Attending_Agent_5__c)||in([15,18], length(Attending_Agent_5__c)))&&(isNull(Attending_Agent_6__c)||in([15,18], length(Attending_Agent_6__c)))&&(isNull(Attending_Agent_7__c)||in([15,18], length(Attending_Agent_7__c)))&&(isNull(Attending_Agent_8__c)||in([15,18], length(Attending_Agent_8__c)))&&(isNull(Attending_Agent_9__c)||in([15,18], length(Attending_Agent_9__c)))&&in([15,18], length({PRESENTING AGENT})),
	disjoint: false) ~> ConditionalSplit3@(validAgent, invalidAgent)
ConditionalSplit3@invalidAgent derive(REJECT_REASON = iif((agents_num >= 10), 'More Than 9 Attending Agents.', concat('Invalid Agent Character Length: ', iif((length(Attending_Agent_1__c) > 0) && not(in([15,18], length(Attending_Agent_1__c))), 'Attending_Agent_1 ', ''), iif((length(Attending_Agent_2__c) > 0) && not(in([15,18], length(Attending_Agent_2__c))), 'Attending_Agent_2 ', ''), iif((length(Attending_Agent_3__c) > 0) && not(in([15,18], length(Attending_Agent_3__c))), 'Attending_Agent_3 ', ''), iif((length(Attending_Agent_4__c) > 0) && not(in([15,18], length(Attending_Agent_4__c))), 'Attending_Agent_4 ', ''), iif((length(Attending_Agent_5__c) > 0) && not(in([15,18], length(Attending_Agent_5__c))), 'Attending_Agent_5 ', ''), iif((length(Attending_Agent_6__c) > 0) && not(in([15,18], length(Attending_Agent_6__c))), 'Attending_Agent_6 ', ''), iif((length(Attending_Agent_7__c) > 0) && not(in([15,18], length(Attending_Agent_7__c))), 'Attending_Agent_7 ', ''), iif((length(Attending_Agent_8__c) > 0) && not(in([15,18], length(Attending_Agent_8__c))), 'Attending_Agent_8 ', ''), iif((length(Attending_Agent_9__c) > 0) && not(in([15,18], length(Attending_Agent_9__c))), 'Attending_Agent_9 ', ''), iif((length({PRESENTING AGENT}) > 0) && not(in([15,18], length({PRESENTING AGENT}))), 'PRESENTING_AGENT ', '')))) ~> DerivedColumn5
DerivedColumn5 select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		REJECT_REASON
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select4
Select3, Select4 union(byName: true)~> Union1
ConditionalSplit1@futureMeetings derive(Start_Time__c = coalesce(toString(toTimestamp(concat({MEETING DATE},' ', {MEETING START TIME}), 'MM/dd/yyyy hh:mm aa')),{MEETING START TIME}),
		End_Time__c = coalesce(toString(toTimestamp(concat({MEETING DATE},' ', {MEETING END TIME}), 'MM/dd/yyyy hh:mm aa')),{MEETING END TIME})) ~> DerivedColumn6
Select2, Select1 union(byName: true)~> Union2
Union2 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['ib_kpma_seminar_update_Meeting__c.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> Future
AddADFId sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['ib_kpma_seminar_update_raw.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> curatedInbound
Union1 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['ib_kpma_seminar_update_source_reject.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> Reject
